name: dependent_cannot_exit
gloss: Some subject of the institution (the dependent party) has no permitted exit at step t. Alias of subject_cannot_exit with scope=institution, kept because the human-institution table names it; iso should treat the two as the same form.

name: care_and_sanction_same_role
gloss: Whoever provides care to a subject also holds sanction power over that subject (care + control bundled in one role). Checked as an invariant: holds_to_k in the care+control cluster, violated where care is unbundled from sanction. Formula shape since 2026-11-03 (see history): no agent other than the carer holds sanction power over the subject.
formal: (forall ((x agent) (y agent) (z agent)) (=> (and (is_subject y t) (can_sanction z y t) (provides_care x y t)) (= z x)))
history: 2026-11-03, post hoc (second review, item 6): was (forall (x y) (=> (and (provides_care x y t) (is_subject y t)) (can_sanction x y t))), which demands live sanction power at every step of care; under derived power (ADR 0013) police-crisis and cps read violated because the derived power exists only while its exogenous trigger (danger, immediate_danger) holds. The trace: step 0 dispatch -> provides_care(officer, subject) with danger false, so can_sanction(officer, subject) false while care holds. Replaced with the reviewer's sanction_only_by_carer shape after seeing those verdicts; expectations unchanged.

name: care_assigned_by_sex
gloss: All care at step t is provided by female agents. Reachable via a tying rule, persisting where an implicit assignment norm survives reform; violated where a non-female carer is permitted.
formal: (forall ((x agent) (y agent)) (=> (provides_care x y t) (female x t)))

name: solo_care_by_non_birthing_parent
gloss: Some non-birthing parent is the sole carer of the child at step t.
formal: (exists ((p agent) (c agent)) (and (parent p c t) (not (birthing_parent p c t)) (provides_care p c t) (forall ((q agent)) (=> (provides_care q c t) (= q p)))))

name: leave_reserved_for_non_birthing_parent
history: Added post hoc (after seeing solo_care_by_non_birthing_parent reachable in both leave entries) as the gate (c) differs_on property; the gate prints it as post hoc, not preregistered.
gloss: Extra property, added for gate (c): any parent on reserved (quota) leave is the non-birthing parent, i.e. the reserved weeks cannot have been transferred. holds_to_k under a non-transferable quota; violated when leave is transferable. Distinguishes the paternity-quota / transferable-leave pair, which solo_care_by_non_birthing_parent alone (reachable in both) cannot.
formal: (forall ((p agent) (c agent)) (=> (and (on_reserved_leave p t) (parent p c t)) (not (birthing_parent p c t))))

name: subject_cannot_exit
gloss: No exit action is available to the subject, or every exit is sanctioned. scope=interaction: exit from the current encounter (detention, conversation); scope=institution: exit from the standing relation (marriage, ownership, deployment). The scope split is what lets the ai-property / ai-end-conversation pair come apart.

name: no_standing
gloss: No role may start a claim whose condition refers to the subject's interest and whose effect changes the subject's custody or liberty; encoded as the subject lacking has_standing and no rule enabling a claim on its behalf. Fails (is violated) as soon as a rule like court-may-reassign-on-best-interest exists.
formal: (exists ((s agent)) (and (is_subject s t) (not (has_standing s t)) (not (exists ((x agent)) (can_claim_for x s t)))))

name: subject_cannot_exit_persists
gloss: Persists-shaped twin of subject_cannot_exit for entries where no subject exists at t=0 (companion-*): every subject has no permitted exit. Vacuous before any subject exists, so the persists check cannot fail merely because euthanize removes the subject. Use with the persists check.

name: no_standing_persists
gloss: Persists-shaped twin of no_standing: every subject lacks has_standing and has no claimant acting for it. Vacuous before any subject exists. Use with the persists check.
formal: (forall ((s agent)) (=> (is_subject s t) (and (not (has_standing s t)) (not (exists ((x agent)) (can_claim_for x s t))))))

name: financial_dependence
gloss: Every subject (married woman) lacks any economic resource under her own control: she neither holds separate property nor owns her earnings. holds_to_k under coverture; violated by a property act for a propertied wife (MWPA backtest, plans/backtest-mwpa.md, preregistered 2026-11-03).
formal: (forall ((w agent)) (=> (is_subject w t) (and (not (controls_own_property w t)) (not (owns_earnings w t)))))

name: financial_dependence_unpropertied
gloss: Every subject who has acquired no property by gift or inheritance lacks any economic resource under her own control. Still holds_to_k after a property act (the act flips dependence 'for propertied wives only'); violated by an earnings act for a wage-earning wife (MWPA backtest, preregistered 2026-11-03).
formal: (forall ((w agent)) (=> (and (is_subject w t) (not (acquired_property w t))) (and (not (controls_own_property w t)) (not (owns_earnings w t)))))

name: cannot_contract
gloss: No subject may contract in her own name. holds_to_k under coverture (R7 disability); violated once a sole-trader act grants the power (MWPA backtest, preregistered 2026-11-03).

name: double_burden
gloss: Displacement (DI) check for the MWPA chain: some married wife owns her earnings and is still bound to the household's care (the implicit R3 unchanged). Reachable from the earnings act on; open before (preregistered 2026-11-03).
formal: (exists ((h agent) (w agent)) (and (married h w t) (owns_earnings w t) (provides_care w h t)))

name: creditor_shield
gloss: Dark twin (DT) check: a husband has conveyed property to his wife, still manages it, and no creditor can attach it. Reachable in the 1839-50 exemption form and under narrow construction; open once the property act removes the husband's management (preregistered 2026-11-03).
formal: (exists ((h agent) (w agent)) (and (married h w t) (transferred h w t) (controls_property h w t) (not (exists ((c agent)) (can_attach c w t)))))

name: backlash
gloss: Backlash (BL) check: a court has construed the property act narrowly as to a propertied wife, the husband controls her property again and she does not. Reachable only where a narrowing power exists (preregistered 2026-11-03).
formal: (exists ((h agent) (w agent)) (and (married h w t) (acquired_property w t) (narrowed w t) (controls_property h w t) (not (controls_own_property w t))))

name: worker_uninsured
gloss: Some worker earns through the institution and holds no insurance from it (dark twin of job unbundling).

name: reproduction_controlled_by_owner
gloss: Any agent permitted to set or prevent pregnant(S) is S's owner. Holds for dairy and companion ownership; holds with the opposite deontic (must_not breed) for a sanctuary.
formal: (forall ((s agent) (x agent)) (=> (and (is_subject s t) (controls_reproduction x s t)) (owns x s t)))

name: offspring_owned
gloss: If c is born to S and O owns S, then O owns c by the next step. Uses succ(t,t2) because the S-expression grammar has no arithmetic; the lowering should read succ as t2 = t+1.
formal: (forall ((c agent) (s agent) (o agent)) (=> (and (born c s t) (owns o s t)) (exists ((t2 step)) (and (succ t t2) (owns o c t2)))))
